messages.subject: The rug geom dialog box
parts:
Hi All,

I've been capturing screen shots of Plot Builder's dialog boxes to document how it works. The rug geom doesn't seem to work like the others. If I do a histogram and drag the rug icon on top of it, the dialog box doesn't appear for me to fill in options as the others do. I can double-click on it in the components window and fill in the values which works fine. But if I capture that screen, the dialog looks different from the others I've captured because it lacks the standard window border which contains the red X in the upper right corner (I'm on Windows 7). 

This isn't that big of a deal, but I suspect the rug geom is created somewhat differently from most other geoms. Or am I just misunderstanding something?

Thanks,
Bob

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: The rug geom dialog box
parts:
You only get the dialog box if there is a required aes. Rug does not
have a required aes.

Ian
